selection: Same inherited value head, same frozen constructor/GRU, same actual future response draws. Compare historical supervised starting states with all measured continuation states, selected only by observed identity. Both conditions use the same gradient-update budget and common source-held Train states; select epochs by equal-benchmark, equal-family sampled remaining-loss targets. The frozen encoder has previously seen these Train sources; this is an inner screening, not independent effectiveness.
gates: All three continuation seeds must strictly improve common held-Train target loss over observed-only, not worsen either benchmark relative to the inherited head, and not increase expected false handoffs. Only then perform an independently sampled actual sequential Train check; full refit and fixed Dev evaluation follow only if that passes. No Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
arithmetic: Use existing FP32 actionPrecision for exact cached-head consistency in both arms; encoder and other heads remain unchanged. Preserve original selected inference bundle and weights until all adoption gates pass.
interpretation: Synthetic/controlled manager replies and documents; actual observed sales for retail loss. Sampled target loss with fixed parent continuation is not new-policy rollout loss or a true optimum.
